note: A three-note tune on one string, played along from the tab. The old Key selector is now moves (any key, 60 to 80 bpm): the app brings the second key, and the {{?key}} line says what stays the same in it.

exercise.title: A first tune on one string
exercise.why: The tune is three long notes, each a step below the last, so your picking hand stays put while the other hand learns to find frets.

cells.text:
Press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}} and see it in the tab: three long notes on one string. Play along from the tab, and let each note ring until the next one.
Practice until you can hum the tune before you play it.
{{?key}}In another key the tune sits on other frets and keeps its shape: three notes, each a step below the last.
